newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP SECOND DAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP SECOND DAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day Red Stripe Cup cricket matches on Saturday:
In Bridgetown: Leeward Islands 339 (S.Williams 141; W.Reid 4-79), Barbados 141 (R.Holder 53) and 163-3 (R.Holder 51 not out).
In San Fernando, Trinidad: Jamaica 349 (I.Garrick 138, J.Adams 66), Trinidad and Tobago 172-5 (B.Lara 75 not out).
In Georgetown: Guyana v Windward Islands - no play because of rain.
